listings.name: Professional Nail And Beauty Supplies
listings.address: Shop 12, 293 Marshall Street, Flora Park Shopping Centre, Flora Park, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Professional Nail And Beauty Supplies is a hair, nail and beauty product supplier trading from Shop 12 in the Flora Park Shopping Centre, stocking nail, beauty, hair and eyelash products and also running nail and beauty training courses.

listings.name: Ruby Stone Boutique Hotel
listings.current_description: Ruby Stone Boutique Hotel is a boutique hotel in Fauna Park with air-conditioned rooms featuring mini-bars, tea/coffee facilities and private balconies, alongside an on-site steakhouse serving African and Western dishes, a lounge, spa treatments and free Wi-Fi.

listings.name: Smart BnB
listings.address: R71 North Mankweng Road, next to Paledi Mall, Ga-Mankoeng, Mankweng, Polokwane
listings.current_description: Smart BnB is a guesthouse in Mankweng offering private, secure self-catering rooms (each with a kettle, fridge, TV and free toiletries) and a terrace, located next to Paledi Mall close to the University of Limpopo and Mankweng Hospital.

listings.name: The Leopard Tree
listings.current_description: The Leopard Tree is an owner-run bed and breakfast guest house in the upmarket Sterpark suburb, with four en-suite bedrooms, a swimming pool, braai facilities and a communal lounge with a fireplace, serving an a la carte breakfast.

listings.name: TlouTlou Cleaning & Pest Control
listings.current_description: TlouTlou Cleaning & Pest Control is a 100% black-owned pest control and cleaning company established in 2006, offering fumigation and pest eradication alongside domestic, carpet and office cleaning services from its Polokwane head office serving all nine provinces.

listings.name: Vision Works Platinum Park
listings.address: Shop 8, Dis-Chem, Platinum Park Shopping Centre, Cnr Outspan Dr & General Maritz St, Bendor Park, Polokwane, 0700
listings.current_description: Vision Works Platinum Park is an optometry practice inside the Platinum Park Shopping Centre in Bendor Park, providing eye tests, spectacles and contact lenses, and is part of the Vision Works optometry group with several branches across Polokwane.

listings.name: Workforce Staffing
listings.current_description: Workforce Staffing's Polokwane branch is part of the JSE-listed Workforce Holdings group, which has operated in the temporary employment services industry for 45 years, providing staffing and recruitment plus outsourced payroll, industrial relations, HR and employee benefits services.

listings.name: All Seasons Function Hire
listings.current_description: All Seasons Function Hire is an event and tent hire company in Futura, supplying marquee and waterproof stretch tents with full setup, arrangement and dismantling of chairs, tables and staging, plus furniture, decor and mobile toilet hire for functions.

listings.name: Allpro Truck and Trailer Components
listings.current_description: Allpro Truck and Trailer Components supplies truck body parts and spares, plus trailer parts and accessories for brands including YTE, Swift, BPW, Henred and Load, along with Mercedes, Cummins and CAT engine parts, from its premises in Superbia, Polokwane.

listings.name: Atrium Boutique Hotel
listings.current_description: Atrium Boutique Hotel is a boutique hotel in Hospital Park offering Standard Rooms, a Deluxe Suite and a first-floor Luxury Penthouse, each with air conditioning, DStv and a bar fridge, plus free WiFi, secure parking and a buffet breakfast.

listings.name: Bosveld Communications
listings.current_description: Bosveld Communications is a Polokwane-based wireless internet service provider that has operated since 1994, offering uncapped wireless broadband, fibre and VoIP/hosted PBX connectivity alongside CCTV, networking and IT support, serving Polokwane and further afield into Limpopo toward Lephalale.

listings.name: Cathedral of the Sacred Heart
listings.current_description: Cathedral of the Sacred Heart is a Roman Catholic cathedral on Biccard Street, built between 1895 and 1897 as one of the earliest churches established in Polokwane (then Pietersburg), and serves as the seat of the Diocese of Polokwane.

listings.name: Danlee Overnight Accommodation
listings.current_description: Danlee Overnight Accommodation is a 6-room bed & breakfast in Capricorn, Polokwane, offering double, triple and family rooms each with air-conditioning, a fridge, microwave, DStv and free Wi-Fi, plus a garden braai area, cooked-to-order breakfast and secure on-site parking.

listings.name: Debonairs Pizza The Greenery
listings.address: Shop 3, The Greenery, 54 Oost Street, Polokwane, 0700
listings.current_description: Debonairs Pizza The Greenery is a branch of the South African pizza delivery and takeaway chain, at Shop 03, The Greenery shopping centre in Polokwane Central, serving the chain's Triple-Decker and Real Deal pizza ranges for collection and delivery.

listings.name: JB Accountants
listings.address: Ismini Office Park, Unit 6, 5 Adj Mauritz Dommisie Street, Welgelegen, Polokwane
listings.current_description: JB Accountants is an accounting firm operating from Ismini Office Park in Welgelegen, describing itself on its Facebook page as a progressive practice focused on giving business owners more time to run their business by handling their financial administration.

listings.name: Mabotja Thabo Attorneys Inc.
listings.current_description: Mabotja Thabo Attorneys Inc. is a law firm in Polokwane Central handling personal injury and RAF claims, family law and divorce, debt collection, estate planning and wills, civil litigation, defamation claims, corporate and commercial law, and urgent bail applications.

listings.name: Orchid Aesthetic Clinic
listings.current_description: Orchid Aesthetic Clinic is a medical aesthetics clinic in Sterpark, Polokwane, offering treatments including Botox and dermal fillers, thread lifting, chemical peels, microneedling, PRP therapy and medical weight-loss programmes, alongside beauty services such as massages, waxing and nail treatments.

listings.name: Tambati Overnight and Conference Center
listings.current_description: Tambati Overnight and Conference Center is a guesthouse in Penina Park offering ground-floor rooms with private bathrooms, air-conditioning and garden views, alongside a garden sun terrace, outdoor swimming pool and a fully equipped conference facility for meetings and events.

listings.name: Tile Africa Polokwane
listings.address: Cnr Nikkel & Nelson Mandela Drive, Superbia, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Tile Africa Polokwane is a branch of the national Tile Africa chain, stocking a wide range of local and imported floor and wall tiles, porcelain and natural stone, along with bathroom fittings and accessories for home and commercial projects.

listings.name: B B Truck & Tractor
listings.current_description: B B Truck & Tractor is an authorised UD Trucks and FAW commercial vehicle dealership in Futura, Polokwane, part of the BB Group since 1993, selling and supporting light, medium and heavy-duty trucks as well as tractors and other machinery.

listings.name: Blue Bottle Liquors The Farmyard
listings.address: The Farmyard Trading Post, Cnr Munnik & School St, Bendor Ext 115, Polokwane, 0700
listings.current_description: Blue Bottle Liquors The Farmyard is a bottle store inside The Farmyard Trading Post in Bendor, part of the Blue Bottle Liquors Group -- one of South Africa's largest independent liquor retailer networks -- stocking wines, spirits, beers and ciders.

listings.name: Bougain Villa Guest House
listings.address: 83 Mc Donald Avenue, Fauna Park, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Bougain Villa Guest House is a guest house and self-catering accommodation in Fauna Park, offering four en-suite rooms plus two self-catering units set around a garden with a communal pool and braai area, with breakfast included and secure gated parking.

listings.name: Galito's City Centre
listings.address: City Centre, Corner Bok & Rissik Street, Polokwane Central
listings.current_description: Galito's City Centre is a flame-grilled peri-peri chicken restaurant inside the City Centre building in Polokwane Central, part of the national Galito's chain known for chicken marinated up to 48 hours and served in flavours from mild to extra-hot peri-peri.

listings.name: Galito's Sasol Madiba Park
listings.address: Nelson Mandela Dr, Seshego-9E Ext 1, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Galito's Sasol Madiba Park is a branch of the flame-grilled peri-peri chicken chain founded in South Africa in 1996, operating from the Sasol filling station on Nelson Mandela Drive in the Madiba Park area with delivery and online ordering available.

listings.name: King Pie
listings.address: Shop 7, Mall@Lebo, Cnr R518 (Zebediela Rd) & R579 (Jane Furse Rd), Lebowakgomo, 0737
listings.current_description: King Pie is a South African pie takeaway chain founded in Pretoria in 1990 and now trading from more than 300 stores nationwide, serving savoury and sweet pies, chips and cold drinks from its Shop 7 outlet in Mall@Lebo.

listings.name: Masamah Graphics
listings.address: Stall Block E2, Mankweng Business Center Complex, Gate 2, Mankweng, Polokwane, 0727
listings.current_description: Masamah Graphics is a graphic design and printing studio at the Mankweng Business Center Complex (Gate 2), offering logo, poster, banner, calendar, business-card and clothing design alongside desktop publishing, paper printing, website design and development, and photography/video editing services.

listings.name: Maswika Consulting Engineers
listings.current_description: Maswika Consulting Engineers is a civil engineering consultancy founded in 2008, offering design, construction supervision and project management for civil infrastructure -- including transportation, water and structural work -- to public- and private-sector clients from its Welgelegen office in Polokwane.

listings.name: Mens Clinic International
listings.address: Suite 111A, Library Gardens, Corner Grobler & Schoeman Street, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Mens Clinic International's Polokwane branch, based in Library Gardens, is part of a national men's sexual health clinic network, offering diagnosis and treatment for erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, low libido and male infertility, plus confidential counselling and personalised treatment plans.

listings.name: PEPPS Ga-Ledwaba Primary School
listings.current_description: PEPPS Ga-Ledwaba Primary School is a primary school in Lebowakgomo offering Early Childhood Development, Foundation Phase and Intermediate Phase education, run under the PEPPS network of Limpopo schools founded in 1998 and operating from its own purpose-built campus since 2016.

listings.name: Phoenix Industrial & Safety Supplies
listings.current_description: Phoenix Industrial & Safety Supplies is a safety-equipment manufacturer and supplier established in 1993, offering workwear, safety footwear, hard hats, cleaning rags and other protective gear to industries such as engineering, construction, mining and petrochemicals from its Superbia, Polokwane branch.

listings.name: Pietersburg Lodge
listings.current_description: Pietersburg Lodge is a 48-room guesthouse in Ivy Park with air-conditioned rooms, DStv, a bar fridge, tea/coffee facilities and Wi-Fi, plus an on-site restaurant and pub, secure parking, a fire pit and braai facilities, and a 24-hour front desk.

listings.name: PNA Mall of the North
listings.address: Shop L32, Mall of the North, Munnik Avenue, Bendor, 0699
listings.current_description: PNA Mall of the North is a one-stop stationery, books and arts & crafts store inside Mall of the North, Bendor, offering school, home and office stationery, art and craft materials, and books including educational, study-guide, fiction and non-fiction titles.

listings.name: Sidze Guest House
listings.current_description: Sidze Guest House is an en-suite guest house in Moregloed with double, queen and king rooms, a conference facility for up to 40 delegates and a smaller boardroom, positioned a few kilometres from Polokwane's CBD and Mall of the North.

listings.name: TPM Attorneys Inc
listings.address: Thabakgolo Building, 3rd Floor, 58-60 Landdros Mare Street, Polokwane Central, Polokwane, 0700
listings.current_description: TPM Attorneys Inc is a Polokwane commercial and civil litigation practice based in the Thabakgolo Building on Landdros Mare Street, handling business and company law, family and matrimonial law, labour law, debt collection, and cyber/data-protection (POPIA) matters across Limpopo.

listings.name: Atlas Battery Polokwane
listings.address: Shop No. 4, PMT Square, Opposite Nirvana Civic Centre, Nirvana, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Atlas Battery Polokwane is the local branch of the national Atlas Battery network at PMT Square, Nirvana, stocking AGM, lithium and other car, commercial and industrial batteries alongside jump starters and smart chargers, with fitment and testing available at the branch.

listings.name: Cashbuild Baobab Gardens
listings.current_description: Cashbuild Baobab Gardens is a branch of the Cashbuild chain, a major Southern African retailer of building materials, timber, cement, bricks, paint, plumbing and hardware supplies for contractors, DIYers and homeowners, located in the Baobab Gardens retail precinct in Thornhill Estate.

listings.name: Fairplay Hardware
listings.address: Stand 23BA, Lebowakgomo Central, behind Mall@Lebo, Mohlala Rd, Lebowakgomo, 0737
listings.current_description: Fairplay Hardware Lebowakgomo is a branch of the Fairplay Hardware Boards & Decor chain, which began in Mokopane and has since expanded across Limpopo, stocking building materials, hardware, home improvement and DIY supplies from its Lebowakgomo Central store behind Mall @ Lebo.

listings.name: Jason Stander Optometrists
listings.address: Shop 7, Cycad Centre, 114 General Maritz Street, Bendor Park, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Jason Stander Optometrists is a family eyecare practice at Cycad Centre with over a decade in Polokwane, offering comprehensive eye exams and a wide range of eyewear from designer brands such as Tom Ford, Gucci and Ray-Ban alongside more affordable options.

listings.name: Maizey Plastics
listings.current_description: Maizey Plastics Polokwane is a branch of Maizey Plastics, one of Southern Africa's largest independently-owned suppliers of semi-finished thermoplastics, stocking signage materials (acrylic, polycarbonate, ACM), engineering plastics (nylon, polypropylene, PTFE) and vehicle wrapping films from its Nikkel St premises in Superbia.

listings.name: PEP Mankweng Paledi Mall
listings.address: Shop 21, Paledi Mall, R71, Mankweng, Polokwane, 0727
listings.current_description: PEP is South Africa's largest single-brand retailer, selling affordable clothing, footwear and homeware for women, men, children and babies, alongside cellular products and financial services such as airtime, money transfers and funeral cover; this branch trades from Paledi Mall in Mankweng.

listings.name: Thomson's Body 107
listings.current_description: Thomson's Body 107 is a Chery-approved panel beating and spray painting workshop on Mangaan Street in Superbia, a family-run auto body business operating for over 30 years and recognised as Polokwane's best panel beater in a 2025 local readers' choice award.

listings.name: Total Sports
listings.address: Shop 39, Mall@Lebo, Cnr R518 (Zebediela Rd) & R579 (Jane Furse Rd), Lebowakgomo, 0737
listings.current_description: Total Sports is TFG's leading sporting goods retail brand in South Africa, founded in 1982 and part of the Foschini Group since 2000, partnering with global brands including Nike, adidas and Under Armour, and trading from Shop 39 in Mall@Lebo.

listings.name: A H Burger Attorney Incorporated
listings.address: 11 Rendezvous Flats, Cnr Thabo Mbeki & Nyala Streets, Fauna Park, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: A H Burger Attorney Incorporated is a Fauna Park law practice established in 2017, handling civil litigation in the Magistrate's and High Courts, the drafting of contracts and wills, and the winding up of deceased estates, taking instructions from correspondent firms nationwide.

listings.name: Auto Supreme
listings.address: The Farmyard Trading Post, Cnr Munnik Avenue & School Road, Bendor, Polokwane
listings.current_description: Auto Supreme is a car wash and vehicle detailing outlet based at The Farmyard Trading Post in Bendor, offering full car washes and detailing to a large regular customer base, with an on-site coffee kiosk for customers to enjoy while they wait.

listings.name: BHL&J Steel Services
listings.current_description: BHL&J Steel Services is a family-owned fencing and structural steel business in Ladine, established in 1990, specialising in palisade, clear-view, wire and game/farm fencing as well as structural steel supply, with an in-house fabrication facility for cutting, welding, drilling and punching.

listings.name: DZB Chartered Accountants
listings.current_description: DZB Chartered Accountants is an auditing and accounting firm in Platinum Park, Bendor Park, preparing financial statements for sole proprietors, partnerships, trusts and companies, and offering bookkeeping, VAT and administration services, as a member of the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants.

listings.name: Hyundai Polokwane
listings.current_description: Hyundai Polokwane is the official Motus-run Hyundai dealership on Tagore Street in Nirvana, selling new and used Hyundai vehicles with its own service and parts departments, as part of the Polokwane Import Multifranchise complex it shares with the neighbouring Kia Polokwane dealership.

listings.name: Kia Polokwane
listings.current_description: Kia Polokwane is the official Motus-run Kia dealership on Tagore Street in Nirvana, selling new and used Kia vehicles alongside servicing, genuine parts and vehicle finance, as part of the Polokwane Import Multifranchise complex it shares with the neighbouring Hyundai Polokwane dealership.

listings.name: Mr Price
listings.address: Shop U62, Mall of the North, Munnik Ave, Bendor, Polokwane, 0699
listings.current_description: Mr Price is a South African discount fashion retailer founded in 1985 in Durban, now the group's flagship chain with over 3,000 stores nationwide, known for affordable, on-trend clothing and homeware. This branch trades from Mall of the North in Bendor.

listings.name: Platinum Auto Panel Beaters
listings.current_description: Platinum Auto Panel Beaters is a panel beating shop in Ladanna offering structural and minor body repairs, spray painting, mag and rim repair, dent and bumper repair, and towing, and is part of the SAMBRA repairer network with RMI and MIBCO approvals.
